comment: The end of an answer still being written, made whole for drawing (D-332). Marks the last paragraph opened and has not closed yet get their closers, in the reverse order of opening. A mark at the very end, with nothing after it yet, is dropped instead. Inside inline code nothing counts. A star with a space after it at the start of a line is a list marker, not emphasis. Earlier paragraphs and an open code block are left as they are.

tails.name: a mark at the very end is dropped
a backtick at the very end is dropped
stars inside code do not count
a list marker is not emphasis
an open code block is left alone
